question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Easily hurt emotionally
solution:
The correct answer is "**Sensitive**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Sensitive: **quick to detect or respond to slight changes, signals, or influences.
 
• **Incensed: **very angry; enraged.
 
• **Senseless: **lacking common sense; wildly foolish.
 
• **Sensible: **done or chosen in accordance with wisdom or prudence; likely to be of benefit.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**sensitive**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
 
• **Example**:* Anindya is a **sensitive **and perceptive student.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] Hinglish__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Sensitive:**** **मामूली बदलावों, संकेतों या प्रभावों का पता लगाने या प्रतिक्रिया करने के लिए त्वरित।
 
• **Incensed:**** **लाल पिला; क्रोधित।
 
• **Senseless:**** **सामान्य ज्ञान की कमी; बेतहाशा मूर्ख।
 
• **Sensible:**** **ज्ञान या विवेक के अनुसार किया या चुना गया; लाभ होने की संभावना है।
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**sensitive**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
